export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}

export class Game {
  constructor(app, options) {
    this.app = app
    this.renderer = app.renderer
    this.options = { ...options }
    this.sfx = sfx
    this.era = getEra(options.eraId)
    this.map = this.era.maps.find(m => m.id === options.mapId) || this.era.maps[0]
    this.playerFaction = getFaction(options.factionId)
    this.enemyFaction = rivalOf(this.playerFaction)
    this.playerRoster = rosterFor(this.playerFaction)
    this.enemyRoster = rosterFor(this.enemyFaction)
    this.buildingsByKey = Object.fromEntries(buildingsFor(this.era.id).map(b => [b.key, b]))

    this.scene = new THREE.Scene()
    this.scene.name = 'Iron Epochs battle'
    this.terrain = new Terrain(this.map, this.scene)
    this.terrain.onDeform = (x, z, r) => this.onTerrainDeform(x, z, r)

    this.camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(46, 1.6, 0.4, 1500)
    this.raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster()
    this.cameraTarget = new THREE.Vector3()
    this.cameraGoal = new THREE.Vector3()
    this.cameraDistance = 108
    this.cameraZoomGoal = 108
    this.pitch = 0.9
    this.yaw = -0.72
    this.shake = 0
    this.viewW = 1440
    this.viewH = 900

    this.units = []
    this.buildings = []
    this.projectiles = []
    this.effects = []
    this.wrecks = []
    this.strikes = []
    this.capturePoints = []
    this.selection = []
    this.particles = new Particles(this.scene, 1900, false)
    this.sparks = new Particles(this.scene, 1100, true)
    this.weather = new Weather(this.scene, this.map)

    this.supplies = GAME_RULES.startSupply
    this.enemySupplies = 1350
    this.income = GAME_RULES.baseIncome
    this.enemyIncome = GAME_RULES.baseIncome
    this.popCap = GAME_RULES.startPopCap
    this.usedPop = 0
    this.queuedPop = 0
    this.elapsed = 0
    this.gameOver = false
    this.endTimer = 0
    this.endShown = false
    this.stats = { kills: 0, built: 0, craters: 0 }
    this.artilleryCooldown = 0
    this.targetingArtillery = false
    this.artilleryPreview = null
    this.mode = null
    this.placement = null
    this.ghost = null
    this.keys = new Set()
    this.pointers = new Map()
    this.drag = null
    this.panDrag = null
    this.pinch = null
    this.hoverEntity = null
    this.hoverAt = 0
    this.mouse = { x: 0, y: 0, ndcX: 0, ndcY: 0 }
    this.econTick = 0
    this.ai = { think: 0, attack: 40, build: 14, guard: 0 }
    this.baseAlert = 0
    this.lastBaseAlert = -30
    this.lastMoveMark = 0
    this.spatialGrid = new Map()
    this.gridTick = 0
    this.overlayTick = 0
    this.overlayFps = 0

    this.playerBase = BASE_POSITIONS[0]
    this.enemyBase = BASE_POSITIONS[1]

    this.setupLights()
    this.setupCamera()
    this.createCapturePoints()
    this.setupBases()
    this.ui = new GameUI(this)
    this.bindEvents()
    this.updateCamera(0, true)
    this.ui.update(true)
    this.ui.toast('COMMAND LINK ESTABLISHED · BUILD YOUR FORCE', 'good')
  }

  get playerUnits() { return this.units.filter(u => u.team === 'player' && !u.dead) }
  get enemyUnits() { return this.units.filter(u => u.team === 'enemy' && !u.dead) }
  get playerBuildings() { return this.buildings.filter(b => b.team === 'player' && !b.dead) }
  get enemyBuildings() { return this.buildings.filter(b => b.team === 'enemy' && !b.dead) }
  get selectedPlayerUnits() { return this.selection.filter(e => e.kind === 'unit' && e.team === 'player' && !e.dead) }
  get selectedOwn() { return this.selection.filter(e => e.team === 'player' && !e.dead) }

  findBuilding(team, key) {
    return this.buildings.find(b => !b.dead && b.team === team && b.def.key === key)
  }
}

installCore(Game.prototype)
installCombat(Game.prototype)
installActions(Game.prototype)
installInput(Game.prototype)

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D WW1/WW2/modern RTS game in the empty `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround` repo, with 3 factions per era, 5 soldiers + 3 vehicles + 2 planes + 3 tanks per faction, 3 dynamic-terrain maps per era, destructible craters, and buildable structures.

## Requirements
- 3 eras: WW1, WW2, Modern.
- Each era: 3 factions ("contrary"/country), each with exactly 5 soldiers, 3 vehicles, 2 planes, 3 tanks.
- Each era: 3 maps.
- Dynamic terrain: bombs/explosions permanently deform ground into craters.
- Buildables.
- Complete playable game, no clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Mobile-responsive layouts and touch controls were implied by repo conventions, not user request.

## Decisions
- Built with Vite + Three.js, no external art assets; all models procedural low-poly via merged geometry and vertex colors.
- One shared renderer with separate menu diorama scene and game scene.
- 3 eras × 3 factions × 13 units = 117 unit definitions generated from shared archetypes with per-faction naming/stat modifiers.
- Factions: WW1 Britain/Germany/Ottoman; WW2 USA/German Reich/USSR; Modern NATO/Russia/China.
- Maps: Flanders/Verdun/Sinai; Normandy/Stalingrad/Pacific; Fulda/Desert Storm/Seoul.
- Terrain: 144-segment heightfield with map-specific noise, vertex colors, props, water on Pacific, weather, and crater deformation with scorch marks.
- Economy: supply income from base, depots, and 3 capturable sectors; population cap from buildings.
- Gameplay: headquarters/barracks/factory/airfield/depot/turret/hospital; AI opponent; victory by destroying enemy HQ.
- Artillery barrage ability (`B`) creates large craters; engineers repair; aircraft auto-orbit/strafe; UI includes roster browser, build menu, inspector, minimap, notifications.
- Vite project type selected because runtime supports it and deployment builds `dist/`.

## Work State
### Completed
- `package.json` created with `three`, `vite`, `@fontsource/barlow-condensed`, `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono`; `npm install` succeeded.
- `index.html` complete: menu, HUD, build/roster/intel panel, selection card, minimap, command dock, end screen, loading layer.
- `src/style.css` complete with era themes, cinematic menu, HUD, mobile layouts.
- `src/data.js` complete: all factions, 117 names/rosters, building stats, 9 maps, rules.
- `src/terrain.js` complete: heightmaps, noise, pre-battle craters, props, water, sky shader, fog, `deform()`, `canBuild()`.
- `src/models.js` complete: merged low-poly soldiers/vehicles/planes/tanks/buildings/flags, selection rings, wreck helper. Patched merged geometries to `toNonIndexed()` and removed double heavy-tank scaling.
- `src/sfx.js` complete synthesized WebAudio engine.
- `src/ui.js` complete: all HUD panels, icons, minimap, toasts, end screen, button callbacks.
- `src/menu.js` complete: menu UI with map thumbnail rendering and live 3D diorama scene.
- `src/util.js` complete: math, team colors, entity helpers.
- `src/particles.js` complete: shader particle systems and weather.
- `src/entities.js` complete: Unit and Building classes with movement, combat, production, construction, turrets, healing.
- `src/game.js` complete: Game class constructor/getters, imports and installs subsystem methods.
- `src/game-core.js` complete: lights, camera setup, capture points, starting bases, economy/pop, update loop, AI, victory/end, health-bar overlay, resize/dispose.

### Active
- Need to implement `src/game-combat.js` (imported by game.js but not yet created).
- Need to implement `src/game-actions.js` (imported but not yet created).
- Need to implement `src/game-input.js` (imported but not yet created).
- Need to create `src/main.js` (app bootstrap, menu↔game switching, render loop, loading removal, `window.__IRON_EPOCHS__` test hook).
- Need to create `vite.config.js` if required (base `./` is passed by runtime).
- Need to build/test and screenshot-verify with Playwright.

### Blocked
- Build currently fails at import resolution because `game-combat.js`, `game-actions.js`, `game-input.js`, and `main.js` are missing.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/game-combat.js` with `installCombat(proto)`:
   - `findEnemyNear`, `fireBullet`, `fireShell`, `impact`, `explosion`, `muzzleFlash`, `smokePuff`, `spawnArtilleryRound`, `beginArtillery`/`callArtillery` helpers if not in actions, `destroyUnit`, `destroyBuilding`, `addWreck`, projectile/artillery effects.
   - Must handle direct/splash damage, terrain `deform()` + `stats.craters`, screen shake, particles/sfx, HQ destruction triggering `checkVictory`.
2. Create `src/game-actions.js` with `installActions(proto)`:
   - `spawnUnit`, `spawnBuilding`, `queueUnit`, `queueForTeam`, `queuedCount`, `productionForCategory`, `findSpawnSpot`, `isPlacementValid`, `beginPlacement`, `updateGhostVisual`, `placeBuilding`/`cancelPlacement`, `beginRally`, `beginAttackMove`, `beginArtillery`, `focusBase`, `focusEnemy`, `focusSelection`, `setCameraTarget`, `requestMenu`, `restart`, `orderRepair`, `returnToBase`, `stopSelected`, `holdSelected`, `cancelModes`.
   - UI call signatures from `src/ui.js` must match exactly.
3. Create `src/game-input.js` with `installInput(proto)`:

330:     separateUnits() {
331:       for (const u of this.units) {
332:         if (u.dead || u.aircraft) continue
333:         const cx = Math.floor(u.x / 18), cz = Math.floor(u.z / 18)
334:         for (let ix = cx - 1; ix <= cx + 1; ix++) {
335:           for (let iz = cz - 1; iz <= cz + 1; iz++) {
336:             const cell = this.spatialGrid.get(`${ix},${iz}`)
337:             if (!cell) continue
338:             for (const o of cell) {
339:               if (o === u || o.dead) continue
340:               const dx = u.x - o.x, dz = u.z - o.z
341:               const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
342:               const minD = (u.radius + o.radius) * 0.48
343:               if (d > 0.001 && d < minD) {
344:                 const push = (minD - d) * 0.5
345:                 u.model.position.x += dx / d * push
346:                 u.model.position.z += dz / d * push
347:               }
348:             }
349:           }
350:         }
351:         for (const b of this.buildings) {
352:           if (b.dead) continue
353:           const dx = u.x - b.x, dz = u.z - b.z
354:           const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
355:           const minD = b.radius + u.radius * 0.45
356:           if (d > 0.001 && d < minD) {
357:             const push = (minD - d) * 0.7
358:             u.model.position.x += dx / d * push
359:             u.model.position.z += dz / d * push
360:           }
361:         }
362:         u.model.position.x = clamp(u.model.position.x, -212, 212)
363:         u.model.position.z = clamp(u.model.position.z, -212, 212)

400:     updateProjectiles(dt) {

412:         const t = p.t

414:         const z = p.start.z + (p.end.z - p.start.z) * t
415:         const y = p.start.y + (p.end.y - p.start.y) * t + Math.sin(Math.PI * t) * p.arc
416:         p.mesh.position.set(x, y, z)
417:         const dx = p.end.x - p.start.x, dz = p.end.z - p.start.z
418:         p.mesh.rotation.y = Math.atan2(dx, dz)
419:         p.mesh.rotation.x = -Math.atan2(p.end.y - p.start.y + Math.cos(Math.PI * t) * p.arc * Math.PI, Math.hypot(dx, dz))

609:         this.overlay.width = Math.floor(w * dpr)
610:         this.overlay.height = Math.floor(h * dpr)
611:         this.overlay.style.width = `${w}px`
612:         this.overlay.style.height = `${h}px`

615:       ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0)

617:       const project = (x, y, z) => {
618:         const v = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z).project(this.camera)
619:         return { x: (v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * w, y: (-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * h, on: v.z > -1 && v.z < 1 }
620:       }

623:         if (u.dead) continue
624:         const selected = u.selected

627:         const hgt = u.def.category === 'soldier' ? 2.9 : u.def.category === 'plane' ? 2.2 : 3.2
628:         const p = project(u.x, u.model.position.y + hgt, u.z)
629:         if (!p.on || p.x < -50 || p.x > w + 50 || p.y < 0 || p.y > h) continue
630:         const bw = u.def.category === 'soldier' ? 26 : u.def.category === 'plane' ? 34 : 40
631:         this.bar(ctx, p.x - bw / 2, p.y, bw, 3, u.hp / u.maxHp, u.team === 'player' ? '#7ad9c5' : '#e0705a', selected)

633:       for (const b of this.buildings) {
634:         if (b.dead) continue
635:         if (!b.selected && b.hp >= b.maxHp - 0.5 && b.built) continue
636:         const p = project(b.x, b.model.position.y + (b.def.key === 'hq' ? 12 : 7), b.z)
637:         if (!p.on || p.x < -60 || p.x > w + 60 || p.y < 0 || p.y > h) continue
638:         const bw = b.def.key === 'hq' ? 64 : 48
639:         if (!b.built) {
640:           this.bar(ctx, p.x - bw / 2, p.y, bw, 4, b.progress, '#d3b77b', true)
641:           ctx.font = '600 8px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace'
642:           ctx.fillStyle = '#d3b77b'
643:           ctx.textAlign = 'center'
644:           ctx.fillText(`${Math.round(b.progress * 100)}%`, p.x, p.y - 4)
645:         } else {
646:           this.bar(ctx, p.x - bw / 2, p.y, bw, 4, b.hp / b.maxHp, b.team === 'player' ? '#7ad9c5' : '#e0705a', b.selected)
647:         }
648:       }

650:       for (const c of this.capturePoints) {
651:         const p = project(c.x, c.group.position.y + 15.5, c.z)
652:         if (!p.on) continue
653:         const color = c.owner === 'player' ? '#7ad9c5' : c.owner === 'enemy' ? '#e0705a' : '#d3b77b'
654:         ctx.font = '600 9px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace'
655:         ctx.textAlign = 'center'
656:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,10,7,0.7)'
657:         ctx.fillRect(p.x - 16, p.y - 7, 32, 12)
658:         ctx.strokeStyle = color
659:         ctx.lineWidth = 1
660:         ctx.strokeRect(p.x - 16, p.y - 7, 32, 12)
661:         ctx.fillStyle = color
662:         const label = c.contested ? '!' : c.owner === 'player' ? `${c.letter} HOLD` : c.owner === 'enemy' ? `${c.letter} LOST` : `${c.letter}`
663:         ctx.fillText(label, p.x, p.y + 2.5)

665:       if (this.baseAlert > 0) {

667:         const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2, Math.min(w, h) * 0.28, w / 2, h / 2, Math.max(w, h) * 0.7)
668:         grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(224,112,90,0)')

bind() {
    const opts = { signal: this.abort.signal }
    document.querySelectorAll('.wt-tab').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.activeTab = btn.dataset.tab
        document.querySelectorAll('.wt-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn))
        this.renderPanels(true)
        this.game.sfx.click()
      }, opts)
    })
    this.$('wt-close').addEventListener('click', () => this.closeTable(), opts)
    this.el.mobileTable.addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.el.warTable.classList.toggle('open')
      this.game.sfx.click()
    }, opts)
    this.$('sel-close').addEventListener('click', () => this.game.clearSelection(), opts)
    this.$('cmd-stop').addEventListener('click', () => { this.game.stopSelected(); this.game.sfx.order() }, opts)
    this.$('cmd-hold').addEventListener('click', () => { this.game.holdSelected(); this.game.sfx.order() }, opts)
    this.$('cmd-attack').addEventListener('click', () => { this.game.beginAttackMove(); this.game.sfx.click() }, opts)
    this.$('cmd-artillery').addEventListener('click', () => { this.game.beginArtillery(); this.game.sfx.click() }, opts)
    this.$('mobile-ability').addEventListener('click', () => this.game.beginArtillery(), opts)
    this.$('cmd-roster').addEventListener('click', () => { this.setTab('roster'); this.openTable() }, opts)
    this.$('cmd-base').addEventListener('click', () => this.game.focusBase(), opts)
    this.$('minimap-zoom').addEventListener('click', () => this.game.focusBase(), opts)
    this.$('placement-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => this.game.cancelPlacement(), opts)
    this.$('menu-return').addEventListener('click', () => this.game.requestMenu(), opts)
    this.$('end-menu').addEventListener('click', () => this.game.requestMenu(), opts)
    this.$('end-rematch').addEventListener('click', () => this.game.restart(), opts)
    this.el.minimap.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => this.minimapPointer(e), opts)
    this.el.minimap.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => { if (e.buttons) this.minimapPointer(e) }, opts)
    this.el.minimap.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault(), opts)
  }
